decision.explanation: Source D1 (segments D1S3-D1S4, D1S9-D1S10, D1S21-D1S22) explicitly identifies 'Piers W. Dent' as the husband of Lady Katherine Ann Townshend, citing Peerage person ID 62667. Source D2 presents a narrative claiming the spouse is 'Rebecca Woodward', but explicitly states Woodward died in 1857 and describes the union as defying 'laws of time and space' involving 'traveling back in time' and 'quantum entanglement'. This content is internally contradictory to physical reality and functions as fiction/hallucination within the provided text, whereas D1 provides a standard biographical record. Therefore, only 'Piers W. Dent' is retained as a valid factual answer.
